Name: Alex After Dark - A Tsundere Dialogue and Event Expansion Pack
Author: loshionbottle
Description:
[url=https://ibb.co/6rGLgt3][img]https://i.ibb.co/9cBSs4F/overview.png[/img][/url]

This mod adds over 450 lines of dialogue for Alex, plus giving him 5 new events & overwriting his vanilla ones! I know this whole series is supposed to be turning all the bachelors into yandere but... I just couldn't see Alex this way, so I turned him Tsundere instead.

[b][color=#e06666][size=3]WARNING: THERE ARE A FEW EVENTS (THE NEW 5 AND 9 HEART) WHICH COULD POTENTIALLY TRIGGER USERS WITH EPILEPSY[/size][/color]

[/b]
[url=https://ibb.co/6Z7yTqB][img]https://i.ibb.co/n0NwYKC/faq.png[/img][/url]

[b][color=#ea9999][i]What portrait mod are you using in the mod photos? [/i][/color]
[/b]I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16838]Rin's Portraits[/url]!

[b][i][color=#ea9999]Is this compatible with...?[/color][/i]
[/b]For most dialogue mods it's an iffy thing. If you're placing in a dialogue mod for Sebastian, then yeah this one'll work fine. On the other hand, If you're ﻿placing in a mod for Alex, like some other Alex dialogue mods, then no. HOWEVER, in the config option there are options to turn off the dialogue/events if you prefer someone else's!

[b][color=#ea9999][i]Can I translate to...?﻿[/i][/color]
[/b]Yes! I give you my full permission to translate to whatever language you're wanting! One major change with this pack is it's setup for i18n! Making your ﻿lives much easier (hopefully). Just be sure to note me as the original author, please!


[url=https://ibb.co/92ppqBy][img]https://i.ibb.co/nfwwD4Q/requirements.png[/img][/url]

You only need [b]Content Patcher[/b] & [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to fully work the mod.


[url=https://ibb.co/4JMC6Lz][img]https://i.ibb.co/HXYRWy6/configmenu.png[/img][/url]
[b][color=#ea9999]PLAYER CONFIGURATION[/color]

Player Pronouns: 
[/b]  ﻿There are 3 slots for you to input your pronouns: 
﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 1: [i]Would typically be something similar to "Them", "Her", "Him".
[/i]  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 2: [i]Would typically be something similar to "They're", "She's", "He's".
[/i]  ﻿  ﻿- Player Pronouns 3: [i]Would typically be something similar to "They", "She", "He".
[/i][b]Player Accessory: [/b]
﻿There are a few events where he tugs on your stated accessory. Keep in mind, one of these is in the pool so.... choose wisely.
﻿If you need an example of how it's used: "Instantly, the fingers that were once tugging at your (accessory) let go."
[b]Pet Name: [/b]
Sets a desired name he refers to you as. I've been told users use things like "Angel", "Sunshine", "Babe", etc.
[b]Descriptive Word: [/b]
﻿Would typically be "Pretty", "Cute", "Handsome", etc.


[b][color=#ea9999]EVENTS/DIALOGUE CONFIGURATION[/color]

[/b]You are able to turn off events in general by toggling "[b]After Dark Events[/b]". 
You are able to turn off dialogue by toggling all four options given: "[b]Generic, Marriage, Gift, Festival[/b]."
﻿You're also able to choose which dialogue shows up, given said options. 


[url=https://ibb.co/qW2rtsC][img]https://i.ibb.co/YyVLzkX/event-triggers.png[/img][/url]

The triggers & console commands for the rewritten vanilla events are the same as base game! 
[b][i]
THE NEW EVENT TRIGGERS ARE AS FOLLOWS:
[/i][/b]
[b]1 Heart Event:[/b] Enter the beach on any non winter, sunny day at anytime.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code]debug ebi SpicyAlexIntro[/code][/*]
[/list][b]3 Heart Event:[/b] Enter Alex's house whenever he's there. You must have seen the vanilla 2 heart event first.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code]debug ebi AlexPumpinIt[/code][/*]
[/list][b]5 Heart Event:[/b] Enter the bathhouse pool anytime from 5pm to 9pm. You must have seen both his vanilla 4 and 5 heart events.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code]debug ebi AlexFirstKiss[/code][/*]
[/list][b]7 Heart Event:[/b] Enter the beach on any non winter, sunny day at anytime. You must have seen the vanilla 6 heart event first.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code]debug ebi AlexShyStalker[/code][/*]
[/list][b]9 Heart Event:[/b] Enter the bathhouse pool anytime from 5pm to 9pm. You must have seen the vanilla 8 heart event first.
[list]
[*]Or to trigger this event via console commands:
[code]debug ebi AlexBathhouseConfront[/code][/*]
[/list]
